title: 一般过去时、did 与原因结果

questions.explanation: 规则动词 visit 在这个过去事件中加 -ed。

questions.prompt: Choose the past form of write.
questions.explanation: write 的不规则过去式是 wrote。

questions.prompt: Choose the past form of go.

questions.explanation: did not 后用动词原形 arrive。

options: Does Maya met the manager yesterday?
questions.explanation: Did 提前，主语后用 meet 原形。

questions.prompt: Choose the short affirmative answer to “Did Maya meet the manager?”
questions.explanation: Did 问句的简短肯定回答使用 did。
did not 后不再使用过去式 arrived。
Did 后的实义动词使用原形 meet。

questions.prompt: What does because introduce in the example?
options: An opposite result with no cause.

questions.explanation: because 后 the interview was important 是练习的原因。

options: The reason the room was quiet.

questions.explanation: so 后 she spoke clearly 是前面安静环境对应的结果。

questions.evidence: Maya practiced because the interview was important.
questions.explanation: because 引出她练习的原因。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that gives a result.

The room was quiet, so she spoke clearly.

questions.evidence: The room was quiet, so she spoke clearly.
questions.explanation: 前句说明安静，so 引出她清楚说话这一结果。

instructions: 阅读中文讲解及例句，再独立完成十二题并根据证据订正。
passage:
1. 描述已结束的过去事件用一般过去时。规则动词通常加 -ed：Maya visited the center. 不规则形式需记忆：She wrote an application. They went to the interview. 时间线索如 yesterday 或 last week 有助判断，但动词也必须变为正确过去式；不说 she writed。

2. 过去时否定用 did not + 动词原形：She did not arrive late. 一般疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形：Did Maya meet the manager? 简短回答 Yes, she did. did 已承担过去时，不再把后面的动词写成过去式；不说 Did Maya met 或 did not arrived。

3. because 引出原因，so 引出结果：Maya practiced because the interview was important. The room was quiet, so she spoke clearly. 两个句子先找原因再找结果；一个基本句中不要重复使用 because ... so。because 和 so 所连接内容必须符合句意，不能只按位置猜测。
